mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and corporate earnings pressure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer and business confidence, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST grow, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), rising employment levels (PAYEMS) signal tight labor markets that increase wage pressures and corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC in the regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate tightening monetary policy with rising inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-housing-starts regime (HOUST > 1250.0), rising real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong demand for housing and consumer goods, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1250.0 and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC in the regime is below 0.03.
